title: Ranger keys in the Build panel
caption: A Ranger at Lv 14 now sees the game's default keys: the Q and E stacks, the mouse and keys 1 to 4. Before, the panel showed stat priority only.

title: Gladiator keys in the Build panel
caption: A Gladiator at Lv 12 sees its Q and E stacks and single keys; Ruinous Blow joins key 4 at Lv 14, when it is learned.

title: Keys follow your level
caption: At Lv 4 a Ranger sees only skills learned by then: Marking Shot on E, Drill Dart on Q, Snipe, Tempest Shot and Snare Shot.

title: Assassin panel unchanged
caption: The Assassin's rotation and key setup at Lv 22 look exactly as before.
